x: Fifteen year old Stuart King, brother of Matthew who has already made his mark in the Club by setting two junior throwing records, smashed his way onto the Belgrave scene at Wimbledon Park with two Club records of his own.
On the field Stuart King heaved the Youth shot out to 13.01 metres for 2nd and just missed the medals in the discus with 37.74 metres and 4th spot.

Stuart King, as dependable as ever, got two seconds in the shot and discus, and Phil Clay also took second in the 'B' shot. M.Gay made a good debut in the 400m and others to catch the eye were of course Pat Lyttle, John Searle, Kevin Clarke and Gary Wilson.
Shot (5kg) · 13.88 · Stuart King · 1st, Inter-County Youth Match 'B', Motspur Pk. · 2 Jul 1978
